Name: 6480's Storage Variety
Description:
This mod was created for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url] and currently adds eight new storage items to the game. More storage containers will be added in the future.

Here are the items added:
[spoiler][b]Ice Cooler[/b] ([i][color=#d5a6bd]Сумка-холодильник[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Cooler de gelo[/color], [color=#ffe599]Glacière[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Hielera[/color], [color=#e06666]便携式冰箱[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts "fresh" items (crops, fish, food, artisan goods, animal products, etc)
﻿- Animated and color-customizable
﻿- 36 storage slots (like a vanilla chest)
﻿- Unlocked from level 3 Farming

[b]Cigar Box [/b]([i][color=#d5a6bd]Коробка для сигар[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Caixa de cigarros[/color], [color=#ffe599]Boite à cigares[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Caja de Cigarros[/color], [color=#e06666]雪茄盒[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts all items
﻿- Animated and color-customizable
﻿- 12 storage slots
﻿- Buy the recipe from Robin

[b]Wooden Cabinet [/b]([i][color=#d5a6bd]Деревянный шкаф[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Armário de madeira[/color], [color=#ffe599]Armoire en bois[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Gabinete de Madera[/color], [color=#e06666]木柜子[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts all items
﻿- Animated and color-customizable
﻿- 60 storage slots
﻿- Buy the recipe from Robin

[b]Lumber Pile[/b] ([i][color=#d5a6bd]Поленница[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Pilha de lenha[/color], [color=#ffe599]Pile de bois[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Pila de Madera[/color], [color=#e06666]便携料堆[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts building materials (wood, stone, minerals, etc)
﻿- Not animated and does not change color
﻿- 48 storage slots
﻿- Unlocked from level 1 Foraging

[b]Adventurer's Pack[/b] ([i][color=#d5a6bd]Рюкзак авантюриста[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Mochila do Aventureiro[/color], [color=#ffe599]Pack de l'aventurier[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Mochila de Aventurero[/color], [color=#e06666]冒险家背包[/color][/i]):
﻿- Held and opened in your inventory
﻿- Cannot be placed down
﻿- Automatically collects artifacts, minerals, and monster loot
﻿- 12 storage slots
﻿- Purchased from Marlon in the Adventurer's Guild

[b]Dimensional Portal [/b]([i][color=#d5a6bd]Пространственный портал[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Portal dimensional[/color], [color=#ffe599]Portail dimensionnel[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Portal Dimensional[/color], [color=#e06666]口袋维度门[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts all items
﻿- Held and opened in your inventory
﻿- Animated!
﻿- 24 storage slots
﻿- Buy the recipe from Krobus

[b]Mini Storage Shed[/b] ([i][color=#d5a6bd]Мини-сарай[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Mini-armazém[/color], [color=#ffe599]Armoire de jardin[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Mini cobertizo de almacenamiento[/color], [color=#e06666]小型储藏室[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts all items
﻿- Animated and color-customizable
﻿- 96 storage slots
﻿- Buy the recipe from Robin

[b]Wrought-Iron Cellar[/b] ([i][color=#d5a6bd]Металлический погреб[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Porão de ferro fundido[/color], [color=#ffe599]Porte de cave en fer forgée[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]Bodega de hierro forjado[/color], [color=#e06666]锻铁地窖[/color][/i]):
﻿- Accepts all items
﻿- Animated and color-customizable (has a different appearance if colored)
﻿- 96 storage slots
﻿- Buy the recipe from Robin
[/spoiler]
Please comment any suggestions you may have regarding balancing, or if I forgot to include any items that seem like they should be able to be put in the Ice Cooler, Lumber Pile, or Adventurer's Pack. Bugs not related to graphics should be reported on Expanded Storage's page.

Installation instructions:
﻿- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url]﻿﻿
﻿- Download the main file from this mod
﻿- Unzip the file using an unzipping program and drag and drop "[XS] 6480's Storage Variety" into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
﻿- You're all set!

You can adjust the settings of any storage items (such as inventory size) by opening [XS] 6480's Storage Variety\<item>.json in a text editor.

Uninstall instructions:
﻿- Delete/sell/trash any of this mod's items from your inventory
﻿- Delete the folder "[XS] 6480's Storage Variety" from your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
﻿- You're all set!
